paragraphs.chinese:
这一集一开始，Phil 的爸爸 Frank 突然开着房车从佛罗里达来了，还给 Dunphy 家带来一只叫 Scout 的狗。孩子们第一眼就爱上了 Scout。Claire 完全没有。

Phil 本来应该提前告诉她家里要来一只狗，可一直拖着没说。Claire 太知道这种事情最后会怎么发展：每个人都保证自己会帮忙，过几天大家都腻了，最后喂狗、收拾残局的人还是她。

可没多久，Claire 听见 Frank 一个人在房车里哭。这个比 Scout 更让她担心。Frank 和妻子几乎从不分开旅行，可这次妻子自己去坐邮轮，Frank 却一个人跑来了。Claire 开始怀疑他们夫妻是不是出了什么问题。

Phil 根本不信。在他眼里，爸爸就是世界上最开心的人，而且父子俩这些年已经养成习惯，任何严肃时刻都能立刻拿笑话糊过去。Claire 指出，这恰恰就是问题：他们天天说话，却从来没真正聊过什么。

Phil 去问 Frank 有没有事。Frank 说没事，又开了个玩笑，Phil 当场就信了。后来 Frank 突然说自己又要上路，而且不是回家，而是继续一个人开着房车到处走。到这里 Phil 自己也开始觉得不太对劲。

Frank 临走前，Phil 终于认真问他到底发生了什么。Frank 承认自己“爱上了别人”。Phil 已经做好迎接家庭灾难的准备，结果 Frank 说的其实是 Scout。他跟这只狗在路上待了好几天，现在根本舍不得把它留下。Phil 和孩子们也已经很喜欢 Scout，但最后 Phil 还是让爸爸把狗带走了。

与此同时，Jay 把 Manny 从学校里带出来，想复制自己小时候和父亲经历过的那种“特别的一天”。两个人去看了一部电影，里面正好有 Mitchell 的老同学 Ben。Jay 一开始不知道那是恐怖片，等发现时已经晚了。

Manny 看完以后彻底被吓坏，开始觉得杀手到处都是。Gloria 气疯了，Jay 却坚持说害怕也是成长的一部分。为了证明电影全是假的，他把 Ben 本人叫到家里，想让他解释给 Manny 听。Ben 偏偏觉得最搞笑的登场方式，是拿着一把假砍刀突然出现在 Manny 的窗外。Manny 当场尖叫，全家一起陷入恐慌。到了最后，所有人干脆挤在一张床上睡。

在 Mitchell 和 Cameron 家，Dylan 的乐队突然没了鼓手。Cameron 以前是音乐老师，马上主动提出顶上。Mitchell 提醒他，他们早就答应要去 Pepper 的聚会。Cameron 这才承认，自己真的需要这次机会。整天待在家里照顾 Lily 已经快把他闷疯了，他想找回一点以前那个自己的感觉。

Mitchell 去看演出，本来只打算待几分钟。可看到 Cameron 在台上那么开心，他最后还是留下来支持。Cameron 还来了一段特别夸张的鼓 solo，下台以后已经觉得自己正式加入乐队。然后原鼓手突然又回来了，这个音乐梦想几乎当场结束。

Phil 终于跟爸爸真正聊了一次，而 Mitchell 也给了 Cameron 一个晚上，让他不只是那个“留在家带孩子的人”。
paragraphs.english:
This episode starts when Phil’s father, Frank, suddenly arrives from Florida in an RV and brings the Dunphys a dog named Scout. The kids fall in love with Scout immediately. Claire does not.

Phil was supposed to warn her about the dog and never did. Claire already knows how this story ends: everybody promises to help, everybody gets bored, and she becomes the one taking care of the dog.

Then Claire hears Frank crying alone in the RV. Frank and his wife almost never spend time apart, but she’s away on a cruise and Frank showed up by himself. Claire starts wondering if something is wrong in their marriage.

Phil doesn’t buy it. His father is the happiest person he knows, and the two of them have spent years turning every serious moment into a joke. Claire points out that they talk all the time, but they never actually talk about anything.

Phil asks Frank if he’s okay. Frank says he is, makes a joke, and Phil accepts the answer immediately. Later Frank announces that he’s leaving again, but instead of going home, he plans to keep driving around. Now even Phil starts wondering.

Just before Frank leaves, Phil finally asks him directly what’s going on. Frank says he has fallen in love. Phil braces himself for a family disaster. Then Frank explains that he means Scout. After spending days on the road with the dog, he can’t stand leaving him behind. Phil and the kids have grown attached to Scout too, but Phil lets his dad take him.

Meanwhile, Jay pulls Manny out of school to give him the kind of special day Jay once had with his own father. They go to see a movie starring Ben, one of Mitchell’s old classmates. Jay doesn’t realize it’s a horror movie until it’s too late.

Manny is terrified afterward, and Gloria is furious. Jay insists getting scared is part of growing up. To prove the movie is fake, he asks Ben to come over and explain it. Ben decides to show up at Manny’s window holding a fake machete. Manny screams, the whole house panics, and by the end everybody is sleeping in the same bed.

At Mitchell and Cameron’s house, Dylan’s band suddenly loses its drummer. Cameron used to teach music and offers to fill in. Mitchell reminds him they already promised to attend Pepper’s party, but Cameron admits he needs this. Staying home with Lily all day has made him stir-crazy, and he wants something that feels like his old life.

Mitchell goes to the gig planning to stay only a few minutes. Then he sees how happy Cameron is and stays. Cameron plays an enormous drum solo and comes offstage convinced he’s basically in the band now. Then the original drummer comes back, ending that dream almost immediately.

Phil finally has a real conversation with his father, and Mitchell gives Cameron a night to be something other than the parent who stays home.
